[Verse 1]
[tab]  [ch]G[/ch]
Two little boys had two little toys[/tab]
[tab]           [ch]G7[/ch]       [ch]C[/ch]
Each had a wooden horse[/tab]
[tab]                      [ch]G[/ch]
Gaily they played, on a summer’s day[/tab]
[tab]   [ch]A[/ch]               [ch]D[/ch]
Warriors both of course[/tab]
[tab]   [ch]G[/ch]
One little chap then had a mishap[/tab]
[tab]                [ch]G7[/ch]     [ch]C[/ch]
Broke off his horse's head[/tab]
[tab]                   [ch]G[/ch]
Wept for his toy, but cried with joy[/tab]
[tab]     [ch]A[/ch]               [ch]D[/ch]     [ch]G[/ch]
When he heard his brother say:[/tab]

[Chorus 1]
[tab]    [ch]G[/ch]                    [ch]C[/ch]         [ch]G[/ch]
"Did you think I would leave you crying[/tab]
[tab]                         [ch]G7[/ch]        [ch]C[/ch]
When there's room on my horse for two?[/tab]
[tab]                                     [ch]G[/ch]
Climb up here, Jack, and stop your crying[/tab]
[tab]       [ch]A[/ch]                        [ch]D[/ch]
We’ll mend up your horse with glue[/tab]
[tab]       [ch]G[/ch]                [ch]C[/ch]         [ch]G[/ch]
When we grow up, we'll both be soldiers[/tab]
[tab]                    [ch]G7[/ch]      [ch]C[/ch]
And our horses will not be toys[/tab]
[tab]                      [ch]G[/ch]
And maybe you will remember[/tab]
[tab]     [ch]A[/ch]        [ch]D[/ch]          [ch]G[/ch]
When we were two little boys"[/tab]

[Verse 2]
[tab]  [ch]G[/ch]
Long years passed, war came at last[/tab]
[tab]               [ch]G7[/ch]     [ch]C[/ch]
Bravely they marched away[/tab]
[tab]                      [ch]G[/ch]
Cannon roared loud, midst that wild crowd[/tab]
[tab]         [ch]A[/ch]                   [ch]D[/ch]
Where wounded and dying Joe lay[/tab]
[tab] [ch]G[/ch]
Then came a cry, a rider dashed by[/tab]
[tab]                [ch]G7[/ch]     [ch]C[/ch]
Out from the ranks of blue[/tab]
[tab]                   [ch]G[/ch]
Galloped away to where Joe lay[/tab]
[tab]     [ch]A[/ch]               [ch]D[/ch]     [ch]G[/ch]
When he heard his brother say:[/tab]

[Chorus 2]
[tab]    [ch]G[/ch]                    [ch]C[/ch]         [ch]G[/ch]
"Did you think I would leave you dying[/tab]
[tab]                         [ch]G7[/ch]        [ch]C[/ch]
When there's room on my horse for two?[/tab]
[tab]                                     [ch]G[/ch]
Climb up here, Jack, we'll soon be flying[/tab]
[tab]         [ch]A[/ch]                   [ch]D[/ch]
To the ranks of the boys in blue[/tab]
[tab]       [ch]G[/ch]             [ch]C[/ch]         [ch]G[/ch]
Can’t you see Jack, I'm all a-tremble?[/tab]
[tab]               [ch]G7[/ch]             [ch]C[/ch]
It may be the flash and the noise[/tab]
[tab]                          [ch]G[/ch]
Or it may be because I remember[/tab]
[tab]      [ch]A[/ch]       [ch]D[/ch]          [ch]G[/ch]
When we were two little boys"[/tab]
